summary: Pseudo-code v0.1 (batch mode) in three files: 06 (conventions, answers to step 5's questions (a)-(i), PH-2 delivery path AL-1..AL-16, FCW register, drawings, risks, change requests; sha256 above), 06a PH-2 hardening AL-17..AL-40 (sha256 dd93ba4676fe63245863a14d378f3781a2af19b42884534be6cf5fe9d226ce9e), 06b later phases AL-41..AL-53 (sha256 dcb6c730a6396644a694c86eb54b8fb628e1694fef6a58143a9299afa095b990). 53 algorithms in the card's form 4.a-4.h with concurrency and crash cases; built facts (main lease, claim/nonce/finalizer, kill switch, activity veto) written as built, deltas marked. 190 FAILS CLOSED WHEN conditions FCW-1..FCW-190 (96 refine AFC-1..AFC-34, all 34 covered; 94 new; 146 with an existing E-n; 44 handed to step 5 as ZR-1). Key answers: back-off ring offsets 0,4,12 then every 20 ticks, none while a line is unsubmitted; READY ordered by adapter at_ms, aged on the receiver's monotonic clock, re-check = same READY seq and epoch; provisional claim does not stamp last_human_at; forward-once needs a lease read after STORED <= 15 000 ms inclusive else a sync read; seams honoured only in a test estate. Finding: built TERMLINK_MAIN_TEST_* lease seams are honoured in production (QR-1, ZR-10). Canonicalisation test vectors (RFC 8032 test key). 21 drawings render (mmdc).

ZR-4: the watchdog holds when the activity veto cannot measure (6.9.7.b); OQ-16 D 3 stays for the normal ring
ZR-5: hub signing-key fingerprint form ed25519: + hex SHA-256 of the public key (6.1.4)
ZR-6: blob wrapper header TLBLOB, version 1, alg id 1, and AEAD associated data binding recipient and plaintext digest (6.4.3, 6.4.5)
ZR-7: adapter contract: prompt_submit with basis doorbell SHOULD carry doorbell_ids; receivers order ready reports by at_ms, tie keeps BUSY (17.2, 17.5.a)
ZR-8: forward-once lease freshness (read after STORED, <= 15 s inclusive, else sync read) and FORWARD-STALE on an unknown lease at X (7.2, 7.3)
ZR-9: revocation.head is signed (schema termlink.revocation-head/1), so an unchanged-head answer cannot hide a revocation (6.2.3)
ZR-10: B-25 deliverable adds: lease test seams honoured only in a test estate, refused elsewhere (built main_lease.rs honours them in production, QR-1)
